title: ObjectFFRF
author: JG
description: Check forceVector and gravity forces in comparison to paper
releaseNotes: objectFFRFforceVectorTest.py: the mass matrix and the applied forces of ObjectFFRF against Zwoelfer and Gerstmayr 2019; gravity by nodal loads is exact, forceVector has no rotational part and gives gravity only for a body with its center of mass at the origin of its frame
